info.author: district
info.name: ui_hud
info.description: Always-on HUD overlay (health/hunger/thirst/voice) rendered inside core_ui's shared CEF browser - client-only, pushes localPlayer's own health via core_ui's PushService channel (see client/HudState.lua). hunger/thirst are placeholders; voice reads gm_voice's exports for the local player's live talk state/mode.
